name: Seeded replay & ghost
oneLiner: Records every run as its seed plus the player's raw input on each fixed step, and plays it back through the game's own step function to the identical end state: the game's state is hashed every second and at the end, so a replay that drifts says DESYNC at the first second it differs, and one that holds says END STATE MATCH with the hash. The best run comes back as a translucent ghost drawn with the hero's own frames and facing that races the player, with a time-trial panel (time, best, live split) and a NEW BEST banner. Replays get a HUD: REPLAY / PAUSED tag, play-pause, speed x.25-x4, a scrubber with checkpoint ticks, the time and a verdict card. Runs save and load as one compact line of text with a checksum. It also counts Math.random calls inside recorded steps, the usual reason a replay drifts.
fits: racing, platformer and arcade time trials (ghost of the best run)
speedrun-friendly action games (shareable replay text, verified end state)
roguelites and puzzle games with daily seeds (replay a seed, compare runs)
any fixed-step 2D canvas game whose update can be made deterministic from a seed
bug reports: a replay text reproduces the exact run
notFor: games whose update uses wall-clock time, variable dt or Math.random that cannot be replaced
online multiplayer (other players' input is not local)
physics engines with hidden native state or float differences across machines (replays may desync between browsers)
turn-based games where a move list is simpler (it works, but a move log is the natural format)

needs: a fixed update step that reads device input once per step (also run by ?t= fast-forward and ?auto=1): rep.input(readInput()) before any autopilot
a deterministic update: all randomness from a seeded RNG whose seed can be set per run; restart(seed, meta) that equals a live run start
state(): the gameplay fields and RNG state to hash; pose() and drawGhost(ctx, pose) with the hero's own frames
begin(seed, meta) where play of a run starts, end({won}) at every win and loss
the live loop calls rep.steps() per fixed tick; render ends with rep.draw(ctx); HUD rects through uiRects()
provides: recorded runs (seed, input stream, checkpoint hashes, end hash, ghost track) and their one-line text form: save / load
replays through the game's step at x.25-x4 with pause, scrub and step, a verdict (END STATE MATCH / DESYNC at a time)
verify(run): an in-place full-speed replay with checkpoint, end-hash and round-trip results (for tests and judges)
a ghost of the best run with a time-trial panel, live split and NEW BEST banner
stats(): steps, distinct inputs, best, playback cursor, randomCalls (Math.random inside steps), errors

assets: module/seeded-replay.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_SeededReplay): canonical input recording, run-length input stream, 64-bit state hash (exact floats, Map, Set, typed arrays), checkpoints, replay through the game's step with speed / pause / seek, in-place verify, GDR1 text format with CRC32, ghost compositing of the host's own sprite (tint, ring, fade), time-trial panel, banners, replay HUD, 3x5 pixel font, Math.random counter
no image, font or audio files
